declaration_status: author/team declaration, not computed from source hashes
environment_control: The same WEXP task owner and coordinated AI session prepare and control both routes and the harness.
expectation_access: The preparation team can read both implementations, all known private reference results, expectations and oracle.
original_consumer_authoring: The private pilot reports a separate implementation task using the agreed contract/public source before a later read-only harness review. This public replay inherits that code; it adds no external-team independence.
participant_delivery: The retained runner stages consumer and native packaging only. Source, receiver policy and output are delivered; the oracle and world id are withheld from recipient inputs.
trusted_producer_scope: Record-alone decisions are compared using identical signed bytes. The harness has the before/after oracle; the recipients do not.
